{{Current events|year=2019|month=02|day=03|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*At the request of Chadian authorities, [[French Air Force]] [[Dassault Mirage 2000|Mirage 2000]] fighter jets strike a convoy of around 40 pickups of an armed group that entered northern [[Chad]] from [[Libya]].  [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-chad-security-france/french-fighter-jets-back-chadian-forces-after-incursion-from-libya-idUSKCN1PT0VN (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Piper PA-46 Malibu disappearance]]
**The wreckage of the [[Piper PA-46|Piper PA-46 Malibu]] light aircraft, which went missing on January 21, 2019, with two people on board, including [[Cardiff City F.C.]] record signing [[Emiliano Sala]], is discovered on the seabed of the [[English Channel]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/emiliano-sala-missing-premier-league-footballers-plane-found-11627529 (Sky News)]

;International relations
*[[Pope Francis]] arrives in [[Abu Dhabi]], [[United Arab Emirates]], becoming the first [[pope]] to visit the [[Arabian Peninsula]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pope-emirates/pope-arrives-in-uae-for-historic-gulf-visit-condemns-yemen-war-idUSKCN1PS0CU (Reuters)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/03/world/middleeast/pope-francis-uae-mideast-muslims.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Atlanta, Georgia|Atlanta]]-based rapper [[21 Savage]] is taken into custody by the [[U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement]] (ICE), accusing him of actually being a [[United Kingdom|British]] national who has been in the United States unlawfully since his visa expired in July 2006. [http://www.fox5atlanta.com/news/rapper-21-savage-taken-into-custody-by-ice-in-atlanta (Fox 5 Atlanta)]
*The Abbott of the [[Santa Maria de Montserrat Abbey|Montserrat Abbey]], in [[Barcelona]], [[Spain]], apologizes for the sexual abuses that a monk did and that came to light two weeks ago. [https://elpais.com/sociedad/2019/02/03/actualidad/1549192942_693881.html (''El País'')]
;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Salvadoran presidential election]]
**Former San Salvador mayor [[Nayib Bukele]] of the [[Grand Alliance for National Unity]] is elected [[President of El Salvador]] with over 50% of the ballots cast. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/el-salvador-elections-nayib-bukele-takes-strong-lead-190204023433625.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.com/mundo/noticias-america-latina-47112059 (BBC Mundo)]

;Sports
*[[Super Bowl LIII]]
**In [[American football]], the [[2018 New England Patriots season|New England Patriots]] defeat the [[2018 Los Angeles Rams season|Los Angeles Rams]] in Super Bowl LIII by a score of 13–3. [https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/super-bowl-2019-score-takeaways-patriots-stifle-rams-to-win-sixth-championship-in-13-3-defensive-battle/ (CBS Sports)]
